The allowlist is exact-origin, stored separately f"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"rom OAuth credentials, and can be inspected or revoked with `trusted-origins` and `untrust-origin`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The CLI remains available for terminal and headless installations:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"For `dsh-tui`, install the bundle into the same profile:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Model catalog"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The plugin reads the Codex CLI/Desktop `models_cache.json` to discover models not yet bundled by pi-"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ai and update their names, input modalities, reasoning levels, and default `context_window`. It chec"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ks the file specified by `DSH_CODEX_MODELS_CACHE`, then `CODEX_HOME/models_cache.json`, then `~/.cod"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ex/models_cache.json`. Only valid entries with `visibility: list` are imported; the maximum expandab"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"le window does not replace the default capacity."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Credentials and privacy"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"dsh keeps this login separate from Codex CLI/Desktop by default:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- credentials are stored at `$DSH_HOME/.openai-codex-auth.json` (`~/.dsh` by default);
- writes are "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"atomic and token refresh is locked across local dsh processes;
- browser status and diagnostics neve"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"r return token values;
- `~/.codex/auth.json` is never copied or modified."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Keeping the stores separate prevents two clients from racing the same rotating refresh token. Removi"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ng the bundle does not delete the credential; use the account page or `logout` command when the loca"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"l account should be removed."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"To share an existing login, set the plugin's `credentialFile` to an absolute JSON file path, for exa"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"mple `C:/Users/you/.codex/auth.json`. Use a regular file, not a symlink or hard link, with owner-only permissions on POS"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ve dsh format. Use a regular file, not a symlink or hard link, with owner-only permissions on POSIX."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The selected credential must contain only recognized fields; unknown fields are rejected before refr"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"esh or writing, with field names but not values in diagnostics. Updates preserve the detected layout"},{"id":"p28s3","text":", recognized metadata, and other providers' independent entries. A provider-local OAuth refresh hand"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ler retains and writes the new access, refresh, and ID tokens, plus email when available, instead of"},{"id":"p28s5","text":" pi-ai's reduced token projection. Login reuses pi-ai's interaction flow followed by one full refres"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"h before saving. A response without an ID token fails explicitly rather than silently retaining stal"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"e identity. Logout clears the selected OAuth fields rather than deleting the shared document, and af"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"fects other consumers of that login."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Compatibility notes"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Current source targets the DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` plugin surfaces and uses its official volatile setting"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"s and `dsh-http-proxy` implementations. - The plugin runs on released dsh plugin surfaces and does not require a modifie"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"d Harness checkout. It can generate attachments and save local output when installed alone.
- ChatGP"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"T plan eligibility, model access, quotas, and backend behavior are controlled by OpenAI and may chan"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"ge.
- The Codex endpoint does not enforce the ordinary Responses `max_output_tokens` field. Compacti"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"on works, but its configured summary cap cannot be imposed server-side on this route.
- Filesystem, "},{"id":"p31s9","text":"shell, skills, MCP, subagents, permissions, attachments, compaction, and the `web_search` tool itsel"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"f still come from the active dsh profile.
- The standalone search endpoint is not a public OpenAI Pl"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"atform API. Compatibility follows the pinned Codex/pi-ai implementation."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"See the design document for protocol, persistence, and lifecycle details."}],"truncated":true}
